nodes.description: Mapping(address=>uint256) tracking the last timestamp each user minted an Alien Kimera; used for the 10 day cooldown check.
Constant price of 60 AMBER (60000000000000000000) required to mint a Kimera.
Hard-coded address of the DraGONS NFT contract used to build the DraGONS interface.
Boolean flag gating whether the AK Protocol mint is active.
Maximum number of Kimeras that can be minted, initialised to MAX_KIMERAS.
Base URI prefix used by _baseURI/tokenURI, settable by the owner.
AmberToken contract instance used for balanceOf and burn during minting.
DraGONS contract instance used to query the caller's DraGON balance.
Public constant hard cap of 5000 Kimeras passed to RandomlyAssigned.
Mapping(uint256=>uint256) in RandomlyAssigned used to shuffle token IDs during random assignment.
Initial token ID offset used in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Public mint function; checks activation, supply, DraGON balance, AMBER balance and cooldown, then mints and burns AMBER.
onlyOwner setter that replaces the AmberToken contract address.
onlyOwner setter that updates the base URI used for token metadata.
onlyOwner toggle that flips the AkpIsActive mint gate.
View function returning the last mint timestamp recorded for a given user.
Internal override in RandomlyAssigned that derives a pseudo-random token index from block values and writes the shuffle matrix.
Constructor initialising ERC721 metadata, RandomlyAssigned supply and the DraGONS interface.
ERC721 internal mint that transfers the token and invokes onERC721Received on contract recipients.
Caller-controlled address used as balance query subject, burn target, mint recipient and cooldown mapping key.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for the cooldown check and as randomness entropy in nextToken.
External call to amberToken.burn(msg.sender, kimeraPrice) that hands control to an arbitrary token contract.
External call to dragons.balanceOf(msg.sender) to verify DraGON ownership.
External call to amberToken.balanceOf(msg.sender) to verify AMBER balance.
_safeMint triggers IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient, yielding control before the cooldown state is updated.
keccak256 over msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit and block.timestamp used as a pseudo-random index.
Address parameter _amber of setAmberToken.
String parameter uri of setBaseURI.
Address parameter user of getLastKimera.
Local holding the result of dragons.balanceOf(msg.sender).
Local holding the result of amberToken.balanceOf(msg.sender).
Local holding block.timestamp at mint time.
Local holding lastKimera[msg.sender] for the cooldown comparison.
Local holding the token ID returned by nextToken.
Local holding the last mint timestamp returned by getLastKimera.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the argument to the external dragons.balanceOf call.
msg.sender is passed as the argument to the external amberToken.balanceOf call.
msg.sender is the _from argument of the external amberToken.burn call.
msg.sender is the recipient passed to _safeMint, which determines the callback target.
msg.sender indexes the lastKimera mapping for read and write of the cooldown value.
msg.sender is one of the entropy inputs to the keccak256 randomness used to pick the token ID.
block.timestamp is stored into the local time used for the mint cooldown.
block.timestamp is hashed as randomness entropy, making token assignment miner-influenceable.
The timestamp local is compared against timerUser (lastKimera[msg.sender]) for the cooldown.
lastKimera[msg.sender] is read into the timerUser local.
time is written back into lastKimera[msg.sender] after the mint.
nextToken returns the token ID that is stored in mintIndex.
maxKimeras is read to enforce totalSupply() < maxKimeras.
AkpIsActive gates execution of the AKProtocol mint function.
kimeraPrice is compared against the AMBER balance returned by amberToken.balanceOf.
kimeraPrice is the _amount argument passed to amberToken.burn.
mintIndex is the token ID supplied to _safeMint.
The dragons state variable supplies the contract instance for the balanceOf external call.
The amberToken state variable supplies the contract instance for the balanceOf external call.
The amberToken state variable supplies the contract instance for the burn external call.
startFrom is added as an offset to the value returned by nextToken.
MAX_KIMERAS is assigned into maxKimeras in the constructor.
tokenMatrix is read and written by nextToken to record used token IDs.
balanceDraGONS holds the DraGON balance used by the require check in AKProtocol.
balanceAmberToken holds the AMBER balance used by the require check in AKProtocol.
lastK is returned by getLastKimera.
AKProtocol invokes nextToken to obtain the token ID to mint.
AKProtocol invokes _safeMint which performs the receiver callback.
AKProtocol executes the external amberToken.burn call after minting.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, allowing reentry into AKProtocol before the cooldown state is committed.
lastKimera[msg.sender] is only written after the _safeMint callback, so a reentrant mint can bypass the 10 day cooldown.
The external burn call hands control to the AmberToken contract, which could reenter AKProtocol before lastKimera is updated.
The external amberToken.balanceOf call reaches attacker-influenced code before the cooldown state is written.
_safeMint delegates to the receiver-callback logic represented by the callback unsafe operation.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amber parameter exists only to be assigned into the amberToken state variable inside setAmberToken.
The uri parameter exists only to be stored into the baseURI state variable inside setBaseURI.
The user parameter is only used to index lastKimera and is fully contained in the getLastKimera view function.
The local is the direct result of the external dragons.balanceOf call in AKProtocol.
The local is the direct result of the external amberToken.balanceOf call in AKProtocol.
The time local is scoped purely to the AKProtocol mint flow for the cooldown check.
The timerUser local is only a transient copy of lastKimera[msg.sender] used inside AKProtocol.
The mintIndex local exists only to carry nextToken's return value into _safeMint within AKProtocol.
The lastK local is only a transient copy of lastKimera[user] returned by getLastKimera.
